item.title: Editorial: Make informed decisions this election season
item.description: Minnesota caucuses officially kicked off the 2026 election season Tuesday night, though unofficially the election season never seems to stop.

item.title: Freeborn County DFLers throw support behind Klobuchar for governor
item.description: As the only candidate thus far in the DFL Party running for Minnesota governor in the 2026 election, U.S. Sen. Amy Klobuchar received all of the support from Freeborn County DFLers Tuesday in the party caucuses at the Albert Lea Eagles Club.

item.title: Immigration, fraud motivate voters in strongly attended Minnesota precinct caucuses
item.description: In a state drawing nonstop national attention, voters jumped Tuesday at the chance to sound off on the immigration and fraud themes that have kept Minnesota in the headlines.

item.description: Sports fans will know that half the fun of sports comes from trying to guess what will happen next.

item.title: Mary Catherine Zimney (1944–2026)
item.description: Mary Catherine Zimney, 81, passed away peacefully on January 25, 2026, at Thorne Crest Senior Living Community in Albert Lea, Minnesota. Born in Windsor, North Dakota, on February 2, 1944, to Anton and Catherine (Staloch) Zimney, Mary was the second eldest of ten children.

item.title: Steve Sorensen
item.description: Steven E. Sorensen 76, passed away at his home in Alden, MN on January 30, 2026. A memorial service will be held at 2pm on Friday, February 6, 2026 at the Redeemer Lutheran Church in Alden, MN. A visitation will be held from 5-7pm on Thursday, February 5, 2026 at the Bayview/Freeborn Funeral Home..

item.title: Cecelia “Ceil” Schnebly
item.description: Cecelia “Ceil” Schnebly, 87, of Shorewood, WI, passed away from Alzheimer's disease on January 19, 2026. She was surrounded by loved ones and caring professionals in her final days. She will be remembered and missed by many.

item.title: Faith Kirsch
item.description: Faith Kirsch, beloved by all who knew her, passed peacefully in her home surrounded by family on January 16, 2026. She lived a life marked by love, kindness, and deep devotion to those around her.
